# Security Advisory: March 2026 Update

> [!WARNING]
> All users running WGDashboard v4.2.x or later and hosted on the public internet are strongly advised to update to the latest release immediately.

## Overview

We have recently been made aware of critical vulnerabilities affecting WGDashboard that, if exploited, could allow unauthorized parties to access the host file system without authentication. We take these issues extremely seriously and sincerely apologize for any concern or disruption this

- **A missing database rebuilds again past a header-only WAL** (#569). In v0.7.5, if `.beads/beads.db` was missing and an orphaned `beads.db-wal` held only its 32-byte header, every command failed with exit 6 and `SYNC_CONFLICT`: "Automatic database recovery refused because unflushed-state preservation could not be established". That includes moving `beads.db` aside during a doctor-style recovery. A header-only WAL is the normal state after a checkpoint, and an ordinary `br create` leaves one behind. A WAL

- WAL-index recovery that meets a stock SQLite reader (bv, the `sqlite3` shell) fails that one command with a retry hint and no longer latches the workspace (#532). A valid empty index left by stock SQLite is admitted without any recovery (#555).
- Stale-schema heal tries the lossless in-place migration first (#551), and `--discard-db-only` no longer drops recoverable unflushed issues (#550).
Seven archives (Linux GNU and musl on amd64/arm64, macOS amd64/arm64, Windows amd64), each with a `.sha256` sidecar

**Reads after bv or `sqlite3` no longer copy the database**
- Every write after a SQLite reader used to copy the whole database twice into a new `.beads/.br_recovery/schema-migrations/` run, and nothing removed them. When the WAL holds no frames, the main database file is already the complete committed state, so recovery now sets aside only the old index plus its receipts. It still checks that the database and WAL come out byte-identical and that the integrity check is clean; if it finds older damage, it re

- `br doctor` names this index state instead of calling `beads.db-shm` inert. `br doctor --repair` still refuses while it is present; run any ordinary br command or `br doctor migrate-schema recover` first.

2. Run `br doctor migrate-schema recover`. It keeps a full copy of the database files under `.beads/.br_recovery/`, rehearses the rebuild on a private copy, and then rebuilds only the stale `-shm` index.
- A tracker left on an older schema, including early br and Go `bd` databases, upgrades itself when everything in it is also in `issues.jsonl`. When some data exists only in the database, mutations refuse and name the issues, and `br doctor migrate-schema heal` upgrades while keeping them.

br 0.7.0 moves the storage engine to FrankenSQLite 0.4.4, keeps both issues when two clones mint the same id, and adds conditional updates for concurrent agents. The database schema is unchanged (19): no migration step is needed from 0.6.0.
- **JSONL import refuses an id that names a different issue ([#512](https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/beads_rust/issues/512)).** Import used to resolve rows by id with last-write-wins, so when two clones minted the same id (typically a child id `<parent>.N`) one issue

This version uses schema 19. Existing databases on supported older schemas require an explicit reviewed migration: start with `br doctor migrate-schema plan`, inspect the plan, and follow its approval instructions. Ordinary opens refuse older schemas. Migration and undo preserve the original database family subject to the documented validation and subsequent-write checks.
- The optional MCP server uses FastMCP 0.9.0 and its required asupersync 0.4.10 and TOML 1.1.5 versions. FrankenSQLite remains 0.3.18; re

- Database namespace admission errors preserve the specific ownership or hard-link failure across read-only opens, reconciliation, schema inspection, and external-project reads. They leave database integrity explicitly unverified.
Source: [`366c69a63fe18260afc4deff798850053954cac9`](https://github.com/Dicklesworthstone/beads_rust/commit/366c69a63fe18260afc4deff798850053954cac9). The storage engine remains FrankenSQLite 0.3.18.

- FrankenSQLite 0.3.18 fixes grouped multi-label counts. Namespace-sidecar permission failures now explain the filesystem limitation and remedy, including affected WSL mounts; repairable POSIX permissions recover before admission checks.
- Deferrals show their remaining interval. Policy gates, initialization receipts, structured output, the `BEADS_DB` alias, and pinned-version upgrades follow their documented contracts.

首个公开版本，功能与 0.1.0 的本机部署一致。

**包含**
- 多账号管理、扫码登录、登录态持久化
- 好友/群聊精确定位，账号级与好友级固定时刻发送
- 文案池与模板（含图片、原生表情），每日防重复
- 自动调度、失败重试、连续失败熔断、Bark 通知
- 会话扫描、火花对账与人工确认、诊断截图

**部署**
见 README 的「快速开始」：Docker Compose 一条命令，数据落在命名卷，升级前请先备
